_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. config.json is gitignored.
Every key can also be set as an environment variable, which wins over this
file. Order is: environment variable > config.json > built-in default.
Only 'root' is required; delete any key you want to leave at its default.
_root: REQUIRED. Working directory holding claude_kb.db, incoming/, processed/, ingest.log. No default - the scripts refuse to start rather than guess. Env: CLAUDE_KB_ROOT
_downloads: Where the browser saves files; kb_open.py watches here for the export zips. Default: ~/Downloads. Env: CLAUDE_KB_DOWNLOADS
_task: Name of the OS scheduled task that runs kb_ingest.py. Default: ClaudeKB-Ingest. Env: CLAUDE_KB_TASK
_python: Interpreter used to invoke claude_kb.py as a subprocess. Default: the running interpreter (sys.executable). Set this when the scheduled task runs under a different Python. Env: CLAUDE_KB_PYTHON
_browser: Full path to a browser that is LOGGED INTO claude.ai. String or list. Default: search Edge then Chrome in the usual Windows/macOS/Linux locations. A configured browser that does not exist is a hard error, never a fall-through to a guess - opening a one-time export URL in the wrong browser destroys it. Env: CLAUDE_KB_BROWSER
_export_dir: Unpacked export directory used by `claude_kb.py build`. Default: the newest data-* directory under root. Not needed for `update`, `search`, or the MCP servers. Env: CLAUDE_KB_EXPORT_DIR
_http_port: Localhost port for `claude_kb.py http`. Default: 8760. Env: CLAUDE_KB_HTTP_PORT
_author: Name written into the generated MCP extension manifest by build_extension.py. Default: Unknown. Env: CLAUDE_KB_AUTHOR
